data.name: 鏡
data.detailed_description:
■ STORY
Midori, a VTuber, has just moved into a cheap one-room apartment in Tokyo.
Furnished, appliances included, not even a stigmatized property — she was relieved, for a moment.
But then she finds a single letter left on top of the washing machine.
"If anyone is reading this, whatever you do — don't look in the mirror. Leave now."
"If you've already looked into it... you can no longer leave this room."
"But there is one way out."

■ HOW TO PLAY
"Anomaly Search" is a first-person psychological horror game where you must find the "anomalies" hidden within a mirror to escape a cursed room.

  • Wander the room and peer into the mirror to find "differences from reality."

  • If you spot an anomaly → go to sleep in the bed.

  • If there's nothing → leave through the front door.

  • Get this right 8 times in a row to successfully escape.

  • A single wrong answer resets the counter to 0.

■ FEATURES

  • 13 types of anomalies that appear only within the mirror

  • A portable hand mirror you can use to peek anywhere in the room

  • Streaming Phase: pick up hints about anomalies from suggestive chat comments

  • 2 endings: a successful escape, and being consumed by the mirror

  • "All Anomalies Mode" unlocked after clearing: a challenge mode to discover all 13 anomaly types in sequence

  • Japanese / English / Chinese supported

■ ESTIMATED PLAY TIME
First clear: 30 minutes – 1 hour
All endings + All Anomalies Mode: 2–3 hours

■This game is a fan game for Vtuber [Unigreen]. Unigreen Channel 🥦
　X Account
　*The game content is fictional.
　　Please refrain from slandering Unigreen.

data.short_description: 都心の格安ワンルームに引っ越した一人暮らしの女の子。 しかしその部屋には、鏡の中だけに現れる「異変」が潜んでいた―― 異変探し一人称ホラーゲーム。鏡を覗き込んで現実との「違い」を見つけ、 8回連続で正解して呪われた部屋から脱出せよ。

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050/ AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and keyboard required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660/ AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and keyboard. For best experience, run on dedicated GPU.
